sloka: श्रेयो मे जीवितान्मर्तुं विहीना या महात्मना ।रामादक्लिष्टचारित्राच्छूराच्छत्रुनिबर्हणात् ।। ५.२४.४३।।।।
transliteration: śreyo me jīvitānmartuṁ vihīnā yā mahātmanā ।rāmādakliṣṭacāritrācchūrācchatrunibarhaṇāt ।। 5.24.43।।।।

translations.english: 'Thereafter we will announce that such a human being is dead. Then Ravana will simply say 'eat her up'. There is no doubt .'
